[[overview]]
== Overview

The fixture combines representative document structure and formatting:

* a nested list with *formatted text*
** a nested item with `monospace` text
* a captioned and linked image

[[workflow]]
== Workflow

. Parse the AsciiDoc source.
. Convert the parsed document.
+
[[workflow-listing]]
.API conversion
[source,rust]
----
let parsed = acdc_parser::parse(source, &parser_options)?;
let processor = Processor::new(options, parsed.document().attributes.clone());
let mut pdf = Vec::new();
processor.write_to(
    parsed.document(),
    &mut pdf,
    Some(source_path),
    None,
    &mut diagnostics,
)?;
----
+
The source block stays attached to its owning list item.
. Parse the resulting PDF and inspect its structure.

The workflow refers back to <<reference-table>> and repeats the named
footnote.footnote:shared[]

[[workflow-example]]
.Expected result
====
The output starts with a PDF header and preserves the document's visible
meaning.
====
